{{Top|leg}}
A '''cargo-flitter''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] used for moving cargo at [[Pellezara station]] in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]]. In addition to its typical usage, the children of the station's [[Datch family|owners]] used souped-up cargo-flitters, along with souped-up [[Cargo tug/Legends|tugs]], to put on flight shows for bored [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were waiting for their [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to be serviced. It was in these shows that future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] member [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] honed his flying skills.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>
